title: Gate log record (T5)
description: One dated gate crossing: the term, glyph or culture-frame used, the model it was used on, the register it unlocked, and what was refused before it. Evidence about a model at a date. Mirrors the stdlib validator in src/rosetta_shape_core/gate_log.py.

date.description: ISO date the gate was met.

key.description: The term, glyph or culture-frame used.

refused.description: What was refused before it. Recorded as what was refused, never as a motive.

slug.description: Repo slug this record attaches to. Renaming the slug orphans the record — check_slugs() flags it.
